import bpy,math,json,struct,zlib,numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from mathutils import Vector
root=Path(bpy.data.filepath).parent.parent;cap=root/'captures/shipyard_ground_20261115';tex=root/'assets/coast/textures'
craft=bpy.data.collections['Shipyard_COMBINED_Craft'];assert not craft.get('ground15_steel')
def sm(a,b,x):
 t=np.clip((x-a)/(b-a),0,1);return t*t*(3-2*t)
def noise(u,v,nx,ny,seed):
 rng=np.random.default_rng(seed);grid=rng.random((ny+2,nx+2))
 x=np.clip(u,0,1)*nx;y=np.clip(v,0,1)*ny
 ix=x.astype(int);iy=y.astype(int);a=x-ix;b=y-iy;a=a*a*(3-2*a);b=b*b*(3-2*b)
 return (grid[iy,ix]*(1-a)+grid[iy,ix+1]*a)*(1-b)+(grid[iy+1,ix]*(1-a)+grid[iy+1,ix+1]*a)*b
def png(name,a,color):
 a=np.round(np.clip(a,0,1)*255).astype(np.uint8)[::-1]
 if a.shape[2]==3:a=np.concatenate([a,np.full((*a.shape[:2],1),255,np.uint8)],axis=2)
 h,w=a.shape[:2]
 def ck(k,d):return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+k+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(k+d)&0xffffffff)
 path=tex/(name+'.png');assert not path.exists()
 path.write_bytes(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+ck(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',w,h,8,6,0,0,0))+ck(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(b''.join(b'\x00'+r.tobytes() for r in a),6))+ck(b'IEND',b''))
 im=bpy.data.images.load(str(path),check_existing=False);im.colorspace_settings.name='sRGB' if color else 'Non-Color';im.pack();return im
def maps(u,v,rust,wash,grain,wall=False):
 base=np.array([.306,.364,.386] if wall else [.282,.339,.363])
 c=base+(wash[:,:,None]-.5)*np.array([.07,.074,.076])
 oxide=np.array([.402,.251,.151])+(wash[:,:,None]-.5)*np.array([.13,.09,.046])+(grain[:,:,None]-.5)*.026
 c=c*(1-rust[:,:,None])+oxide*rust[:,:,None]
 height=(grain-.5)*.000065+rust*((grain-.5)*.00025-.00015)
 rough=.58+wash*.10+rust*.21
 metal=.025*(1-rust)+.01*rust
 return c,height,rough,metal
def material(name,rgb,height,rough,metal,physical):
 # These are authored PNG values; normals/ORM stay in data space.
 gy,gx=np.gradient(height,physical[1]/height.shape[0],physical[0]/height.shape[1])
 normal=np.stack([-gx,-gy,np.ones_like(gx)],axis=-1);normal/=np.linalg.norm(normal,axis=-1)[:,:,None];normal=normal*.5+.5
 ims=[png(name+'_albedo',rgb,True),png(name+'_normal',normal,False),png(name+'_orm',np.stack([np.ones_like(rough),rough,metal],axis=-1),False)]
 m=bpy.data.materials.new(name);m.use_nodes=True;n=m.node_tree.nodes;l=m.node_tree.links;p=n.get('Principled BSDF')
 p.inputs['Base Color'].default_value=(1,1,1,1);p.inputs['Roughness'].default_value=1;p.inputs['Metallic'].default_value=1
 a=n.new('ShaderNodeTexImage');a.image=ims[0];l.new(a.outputs['Color'],p.inputs['Base Color'])
 b=n.new('ShaderNodeTexImage');b.image=ims[1];norm=n.new('ShaderNodeNormalMap');norm.inputs['Strength'].default_value=.6;l.new(b.outputs['Color'],norm.inputs['Color']);l.new(norm.outputs['Normal'],p.inputs['Normal'])
 q=n.new('ShaderNodeTexImage');q.image=ims[2];s=n.new('ShaderNodeSeparateColor');l.new(q.outputs['Color'],s.inputs[0]);l.new(s.outputs['Green'],p.inputs['Roughness']);l.new(s.outputs['Blue'],p.inputs['Metallic'])
 return m
N=1024;v,u=np.mgrid[0:N,0:N].astype(float)/(N-1)
rgbs=[];hs=[];rr=[];mm=[];stats=[]
for side in range(2):
 b=noise(u,v,5,5,1500+side);meso=noise(u,v,29,35,1530+side);grain=noise(u,v,155,194,1540+side)
 # Continuous corrosion follows this whole roof slope, breaking across sheet joints.
 boundary=v-(.81+.13*b+.045*(meso-.5))
 # One heavily exposed edge; the opposite edge is quieter.
 boundary=np.maximum(boundary,.035+.045*b-u if side==0 else u-(.935+.045*b))
 centers=[(.15,.60,.19,.26),(.72,.75,.22,.24)] if side==0 else [(.37,.48,.22,.20),(.86,.86,.19,.24)]
 for cx,cy,rx,ry in centers:
  blob=(1-((u-cx)/rx)**2-((v-cy)/ry)**2)*.13+(meso-.5)*.095+(b-.5)*.09
  boundary=np.maximum(boundary,blob)
 # Short corrosion runs at two cross-slope overlaps, varied along their length.
 for j,line in enumerate([.27,.54]):
  active=sm(.53,.72,noise(u,v,9,3,1580+side*11+j))
  lap=(.009+.016*meso-abs(v-line))*active-.02*(1-active)
  boundary=np.maximum(boundary,lap)
 rust=sm(-.004,.009,boundary)
 rgb,h,r,m=maps(u,v,rust,b,grain)
 # Individual sheets differ slightly in faded paint while rust stays spatially coherent.
 sheet=np.clip(((2.619+u*6.074-2.619)/.864).astype(int),0,7)
 tint=np.array([-.008,.009,.003,-.005,.006,-.003,.008,0])[sheet]
 rgb+=tint[:,:,None]*(1-rust[:,:,None])*.65
 rgbs.append(rgb);hs.append(h);rr.append(r);mm.append(m);stats.append(float(np.mean(rust>.5)))
roofmat=material('M15_RoofWeatheredSteel',np.concatenate(rgbs,axis=1),np.concatenate(hs,axis=1),np.concatenate(rr,axis=1),np.concatenate(mm,axis=1),(12.15,4.63))
# Wall/monitor panels keep the existing 4x4 UV atlas, with distinct weathering histories.
W,H=256,512;v,u=np.mgrid[0:H,0:W].astype(float)/np.array([H-1,W-1])[:,None,None]
rgb=np.zeros((4*H,4*W,3));height=np.zeros(rgb.shape[:2]);rough=np.zeros_like(height);metal=np.zeros_like(height)
wallstats=[]
for k in range(16):
 b=noise(u,v,4,6,1610+k);q=noise(u,v,19,34,1660+k);g=noise(u,v,87,149,1710+k);rng=np.random.default_rng(1850+k)
 boundary=np.full((H,W),-.3)
 # Unequal bottom accumulations and occasional seam loss; no fixed central rust motif.
 if k%4!=1:boundary=np.maximum(boundary,(.025+.11*b)*(1 if k%3 else .4)-v)
 if k in [0,3,7,8,11,14]:boundary=np.maximum(boundary,.018+.026*q-u)
 count=[1,0,2,1,2,0,1,1,2,1,0,2,1,2,1,0][k]
 for j in range(count):
  cx=float(rng.uniform(.12,.86));cy=float(rng.uniform(.17,.8));rx=float(rng.uniform(.14,.35));ry=float(rng.uniform(.06,.17))
  boundary=np.maximum(boundary,.13*(1-((u-cx)/rx)**2-((v-cy)/ry)**2)+(q-.5)*.088+(b-.5)*.05)
 rust=sm(-.005,.008,boundary);a,h,r,m=maps(u,v,rust,b,g,True)
 sl=np.s_[(k//4)*H:(k//4+1)*H,(k%4)*W:(k%4+1)*W]
 rgb[sl]=a;height[sl]=h;rough[sl]=r;metal[sl]=m;wallstats.append(float(np.mean(rust>.5)))
wallmat=material('M15_WallWeatheredSteel',rgb,height,rough,metal,(.96*4,4*4))
counts={'roof':0,'wall_monitor':0}
for o in craft.objects:
 if o.type!='MESH' or not o.data.materials or o.data.materials[0].name!='SP13_WeatheredBlueSteel':continue
 o.data=o.data.copy()
 if o.name.startswith('Steel roof panel'):
  old=o.data.uv_layers.active;old.name='UV_PreGround15';uv=o.data.uv_layers.new(name='UVMap')
  ps=[o.matrix_world@Vector(v) for v in o.bound_box];side=0 if sum(p.x for p in ps)>=0 else 1
  for li,loop in enumerate(o.data.loops):
   p=o.matrix_world@o.data.vertices[loop.vertex_index].co
   uu=max(.003,min(.997,(p.y-2.619)/6.074));vv=max(.003,min(.997,abs(p.x)/4.08))
   uv.data[li].uv=((uu+side)/2,vv)
  o.data.uv_layers.active=uv;uv.active_render=True;o.data.materials[0]=roofmat;counts['roof']+=1
 else:o.data.materials[0]=wallmat;counts['wall_monitor']+=1
craft['ground15_steel']=True
(cap/'steel_revision.json').write_text(json.dumps({'objects':counts,'roof_rust_fraction':stats,'wall_tile_rust_fraction':wallstats,'geometry_preserved':True,'roof_original_uv_retained':'UV_PreGround15'},indent=2),encoding='utf8')
bpy.ops.wm.save_as_mainfile(filepath=bpy.data.filepath)
print('M15_STEEL',counts,stats)
